hair.title: Hair Salon in Antalya: Cut, Colour, Blow-dry | Can Beauty Studio
hair.desc: Hair salon in Antalya for cuts, colour, blow-dry and hair care at partner salons. Message us your area and we direct you; price on WhatsApp.

hair.lead: Tell us on WhatsApp what you want done to your hair and where you are staying, and we will direct you to a partner salon in your area. Cuts, colour, blow-dry and hair care are available; you get the price on WhatsApp.
fit: Visitors who want a fresh cut or a new colour while on holiday.
Guests who need a blow-dry or styling before a dinner, wedding or party.
Anyone who wants to look after hair that has had sea, sun and pool.
expect: You describe the work; a reference photo of the look you like makes it easier to explain.
We suggest a partner salon for your area and the day and time are agreed on WhatsApp.
Day and time are confirmed on WhatsApp; the salon details are shared when you book.
faq: Should I send a photo before a colouring appointment?
A photo of the shade or style you want speeds up the quote and the booking. The price depends on the details and is given on WhatsApp.
Can I book a cut and a blow-dry together?
Write both on WhatsApp; availability and the time slot are confirmed with the salon.
Do you also direct men looking for a haircut?
Send your request and area, and we tell you on WhatsApp whether a salon can take it.

nails.h1: Nail Salon in Antalya: Manicure, Pedicure and Gel Polish
nails.name: Nails
nails.lead: For a manicure, pedicure, gel polish or nail extensions, tell us the service and your area on WhatsApp. We direct you to a partner salon and share the price there.
fit: Visitors who want neat, long-lasting nails for the whole holiday.
Sandal-and-beach weather, when a pedicure is the obvious choice.
Anyone refreshing colour and shape for a special day.

A photo of a design you like, if you have one.
The day and time are agreed on WhatsApp; the salon details are shared when you book.
faq: Are gel polish and nail extensions the same thing?
No. Gel polish is a long-lasting colour applied to your own nail, while extensions add length. Tell us which one you want.
Can I book a manicure and a pedicure together?
Yes, write both. Timing and availability are confirmed with the salon on WhatsApp.
Do I have to send a design photo?
Not required, but showing the style you like helps the salon understand your wish.

Can I have skin care before makeup?
